last_ui: Before Tasker can work, please check all the boxes below...
Tasker can do a lot of things, so please read and accept the usage terms to proceed.
Click here to enable. Starting in Android 10 Tasker needs to always have the 'Draw Over Other Apps' permission to be able to do stuff like opening apps from the background.
Tasker may not work well in many situations while it is being battery-optimized by Android, particularly on Android 8 or above.

IMPORTANT NOTE: It's very important that Tasker is not battery optimized or it won't work correctly.

Different vendors (Huawei, Samsung, OnePlus, etc) have different non-standard ways to optimize battery which can break Tasker.

Please make sure to disable ALL battery optimizations specific to your vendor.

Learn how to do this now?
